title: (Biographies) Martin Luther
description: In this sermon, Pastor John Piper emphasizes the importance of studying the word of God and rebukes the notion that one cannot be productive or find time for study due to other responsibilities. He draws inspiration from Martin Luther, who emphasized the value of studying the Bible and the languages it was written in. Luther's diligence in studying and translating the Bible, despite facing obstacles, serves as an example for believers today. Piper encourages listeners to approach the study of scripture with humility, prayer, and a desire to understand and apply its teachings.
